deep.reconstruction: Context (pp. 51-53). Grothendieck encodes a space X with a closed cover (X_i)_{i in I} indexed by a poset as a simplicial 'flag space' X_{Δ*}. Here X_{Δ0} is the disjoint union of the X_i, and X_{Δ1} ⊂ X_{Δ0}×X_{Δ0} is the set of pairs (x∈X_i, x∈X_j) with i≤j. On the previous page, under (21) c) X = ∪X_i and d) X_i∩X_j = ∪_{k≤i,j} X_k, the colimit of X_{Δ*} maps homeomorphically onto X (formula 22). This page is the converse 'Corollary'. Start from an ordered topological space (X_{Δ0}, X_{Δ1} ⊂ X_{Δ0}×X_{Δ0}), i.e. an internal poset in Top, together with a partition of X_{Δ0} into clopen pieces X_i. Assume (23): a) X_{Δ1} is closed in X_{Δ0}×X_{Δ0}; b) for each (i,j), Γ_ij = X_{Δ1} ∩ (X_i×X_j) is either empty or the graph of a closed immersion f_ij: X_i → X_j. Then the source map a: X_{Δ1} → X_{Δ0} is a trivial ('constant') covering, since over X_i it is ⊔_{j: Γ_ij≠∅} X_i. The target map b is a local immersion, a closed immersion on each Γ_ij. Claims: (1) i≤j ⇔ Γ_ij≠∅ is a partial order on I. (2) The f_ij form an I-indexed inductive system of closed immersions. (3) Ordered spaces with clopen partition satisfying (23) are the same thing as inductive systems of closed immersions indexed by a poset. (4) Tentatively ('si je comprends'), if I is finite and binary infima exist, then X = colim_I X_i ≅ X_{Δ0}/(equivalence relation generated by X_{Δ1}), and the X_i → X are closed immersions. The purpose is to recover a (stratified) space and its closed strata closures from purely 'simplicial/ordered' data. This is a step toward describing stratified spaces and topoi via flag spaces. The next page asks whether to strengthen (21 d) to X_{i∧j} = X_i ∩ X_j, and rejects that because of cone examples.
errors: Reflexivity of the induced order on I needs each X_i nonempty: if X_i = ∅ then Γ_ii = ∅. Empty pieces must be excluded.

Antisymmetry and functoriality are not argued; they do hold. Γ_ii contains the diagonal, so Γ_ii = Δ and f_ii = id. Transitivity of X_{Δ1} plus single-valuedness gives f_jk∘f_ij = f_ik. If i≤j≤i then f_ji∘f_ij = id, and antisymmetry of the order on X_{Δ0} forces x = f_ij(x), so i = j since the pieces are disjoint.

Claim (4) is flagged as uncertain by G. himself. Injectivity of X_i → colim can be checked for short zigzags using joins of bounded pairs (finite meet-semilattice). However, the identification of the preimage of X_i in X_j, and its closedness, depends on whether X_{i∧j} equals X_i ∩ X_j in the colimit. This is exactly the question of the next page, so the 'etc.' hides a genuine gap.

The statement 'the datum of the ordered space with the partition amounts to such an inductive system' also needs the equivalence relation on X_{Δ0} to be generated compatibly. This is essentially automatic but unstated.

ideas.what: Encoding a poset-indexed diagram of closed immersions as an internal poset (ordered topological space) with clopen partition, source map a trivial covering, target map a local immersion
ideas.modern_name: Grothendieck construction / topological poset (topological category) associated to a diagram; nerve of a closed cover
ideas.usually_credited_to: Segal (1968, topological category of a cover); standard folklore

ideas.what: Space glued along a finite meet-semilattice of closed immersions as colimit = quotient of the disjoint union by the generated equivalence relation, with X_i closed in X
ideas.modern_name: gluing of spaces along closed subspaces; colimit of closed embeddings; poset-stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (CW/simplicial gluing, Lurie HA App. A for poset-stratified spaces)

missed.claim: G. leaves open exactly which hypotheses on the poset (finite, infima, possibly X_{i∧j}=X_i∩X_j) make colim X_i ≅ X_{Δ0}/X_{Δ1} with closed X_i → X. He then argues on the next page against requiring the strengthened condition, because of cones over stratifications with disconnected intersections of strata. This is a minor foundational point, essentially settled in modern poset-stratified-space frameworks.
missed.quote: Supposons de plus pour nous mettre à l'aise que I est fini, et que la Inf de deux éléments y existe - alors (si je compr.) X = lim X_i ≃ X_{Δ0}/(X_{Δ1} ⇉) et les X_i ↪ X sont des imm. fermées etc....
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is only marginally relevant, as a historical precursor of describing stratified spaces by simplicial 'flag spaces' (cf. exit-path and décollement approaches); no new mathematics.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine foundational bookkeeping: translating poset-indexed closed covers into an ordered space / simplicial flag space and back. It is standard folklore, interesting only as context for G.'s 1981 stratified-topos project.
transcription_corrections: 'la donnée de l'espace {+top.+} indexé X_{Δ0}' should read 'la donnée de l'espace top./ordonné X_{Δ0}' (topological ordered space).
The word inserted above 'rev.' is uncertain: it reads more like 'triv.' (trivial covering, consistent with '(constant)') than 'étale'.
'forment un système inductif d'espaces topologiques' is correct; 'Inf de deux éléments y existe' is correct.
